sourceTitle: TCEA Module 8 — Project Management and Change Leadership

case.title: The portable classroom is still offline
case.facts: A fictional portable classroom remains offline after work stalled between facilities and IT. The principal receives assurances but no dependable completion date. Use only fictional or generalized details.

agenda.title: See beyond the technical rollout
agenda.prompt: Meet the shared district case. What decision is needed before anyone promises a completion date?

agenda.title: Model scope, stakeholders, and milestones
agenda.prompt: Follow the presenter’s charter and milestone model. Which boundary or stakeholder would you clarify?

agenda.title: Teach dependencies, risks, and communication
agenda.prompt: Examine the worked handoff, risk response, and update. Discuss who should act next and why.

agenda.title: Lead change and measure what works
agenda.prompt: Compare delivery and adoption KPIs. Discuss a barrier to use and choose a useful support response.

agenda.title: Discuss the next decision
agenda.prompt: Use the shared case and the presenter’s completed framework. Discuss one next action, an accountable owner, and the evidence to check.

agenda.title: Review the framework and take the templates
agenda.prompt: Check the success criteria, review the model decision, and locate the reusable templates.

participation: Follow presenter models, think briefly, discuss a decision with a neighbor, and compare with the worked example. No project, preparation, or device required.
sourceNote: Selected ideas from the supplied four-hour module are taught through a shared district case within fifty minutes. Templates are takeaways, not required prework or a full project assignment.

initiativeExamples.planningQuestion: Who verifies readiness before devices reach classrooms?
initiativeExamples.deliveryKPI: Share of scheduled devices configured and accepted
initiativeExamples.adoptionKPI: Share of intended classrooms completing the agreed learning workflow

initiativeExamples.planningQuestion: How will staff receive support when the new sign-in step fails?
initiativeExamples.deliveryKPI: Share of in-scope accounts enrolled in the approved sign-in process
initiativeExamples.adoptionKPI: Successful use of that process and unresolved access barriers

initiativeExamples.planningQuestion: Who accepts the service at the classroom handoff?
initiativeExamples.deliveryKPI: Share of planned locations passing agreed service tests
initiativeExamples.adoptionKPI: Successful classroom use during the intended teaching workflow

initiativeExamples.planningQuestion: Who approves the pilot scope and listens to staff concerns?
initiativeExamples.deliveryKPI: Readiness of approved pilot access, guidance, and support
initiativeExamples.adoptionKPI: Observed use of the approved workflow and unresolved support needs
